key: Something unseeable is in the way.
en: Something unseeable is in the way.
ja: 何か見えない気配が道をふさいでいる。
\PNはシルボンスコープを使った。
驚いたポケモンがおそいかかってきた!

key: You ever stop to look over how this city has changed?
en: You ever stop to look over how this city has changed?
ja: この街がどう変わったか、じっくり眺めたことあるかい?

key: I been catchin' stuff up here all day, but then this view caught my eye.
en: I been catchin' stuff up here all day, but then this view caught my eye.
ja: 一日中ここで捕まえてたんだけど、ふとこの景色に目を奪われちまってさ。

key: It's grown into a fine city.
en: It's grown into a fine city.
ja: 立派な街に育ったもんだ。

key: Maybe I should help it grow a little more.
en: Maybe I should help it grow a little more.
ja: オレも、もう少しこの街の成長に力を貸すべきかもな。

key: So, they're hurting for hands down at Coral?
en: So, they're hurting for hands down at Coral?
ja: コーラルじゃ人手が足りなくて困ってるのか?

key: All right, restin' up here has got me invigorated. I'll go give it a try!
en: All right, restin' up here has got me invigorated. I'll go give it a try!
ja: よし、ここで休んだら元気が出てきた。行って手伝ってみるか!
